items.title: Local convergence on finite polyhedral cells
items.note: polyhedral states the theorem with all hypotheses: n ≥ 1, F convex with unique minimizer x* (hmin, huniq), U open ∋ x*, finitely many cells (index type ι with Fintype) P i = {x | ∀ j, a_ij^T x ≤ b_ij} (a polyhedron is closed, polyhedron_closed), full-dimensional ((interior (P i)).Nonempty), U ⊆ ⋃ P i, open V i ⊇ U ∩ P i, f i ∈ C^{1,1}_loc(V i) (CenteredSmoothSublinear.LocallyC11On (V i) (f i) = DifferentiableOn ∧ LocallyLipschitzOn of fderiv), F = f i on U ∩ P i (disp/001). Conclusion: ∃ ε > 0 such that every AdmissibleBFGSRun n F (Definition art:admissible: infinite full-BFGS run, arbitrary H_0 ≻ 0, differentiable accepted iterates, fixed 0 < c1 < c2 < 1) with F(x_0) ≤ F(x*) + ε satisfies disp/002; ε precedes the run (basin chosen before the run and its initial matrix). No convexity of the f i is assumed. The hypotheses n ≥ 1 and full-dimensionality are not used by the Lean proof (the library theorem allows lower-dimensional cells). The proof (local.tex:48-76) is item A/local/proof/002.
The conclusion (∀ k, R.x k ∈ U) ∧ F(x_k) → F(x*) ∧ x_k → x* of PositivePartition.polyhedral.
